entities.summary: Achim Müller was a German inorganic chemist. Mainly as a professor at the University of Bielefeld, he contributed extensively to the chemistry of molybdenum oxides and sulfides. He died on 28 February 2024, at the age of 86.

entities.summary: Achim Müller was a German inorganic chemist. Mainly as a professor at the University of Bielefeld, he contributed extensively to the chemistry of molybdenum oxides and sulfides. He died on 28 February 2024, at the age of 86.
